- [ ] **2.1 Define Drizzle schema — agencies table** — id, slug (unique), name, brandName, logoUrl, websiteUrl, phone, email, streetAddress, suburb, state, postcode, latitude, longitude, description, totalAgents, totalSalesCount, totalSalesVolume, sourceUrl, lastScrapedAt, createdAt, updatedAt; indexes on slug, state, postcode

- [ ] **2.3 Define Drizzle schema — suburbs table** — id, slug (unique), name, state (enum 8 values), postcode, latitude, longitude, localGovernmentArea, stateElectorate, totalAgents, medianHousePrice, medianUnitPrice, timestamps; indexes on slug, state, postcode, composite (name, state)
